# mabinogi-011 — establishment log (2026-11-14)

Evans 1907 cols 81 l. 20 – 89 l. 12 (PDF pp. 73–77). Every column read on the page image (zoom 4–4.5, three crops
per column plus the page foot; zoom 10 for single lines). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness
used only to locate disagreements and for punctuation and paragraph shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w;
r-rotunda → r; ſ → s; raised letters into the line; line-end marks and Evans's dotted/wavy underlines dropped.

Tooling note: crops cut with PyMuPDF. Odd pages (73, 75, 77): columns at x ≈ 0–125 / 110–245; even pages (74, 76):
x ≈ 88–228 / 208–335; text y ≈ 40–400 (the last four lines of each column lie below y 335).

## Opening and close
- col 81 l. 20 — large initial **M** (the OCR's "#|\ Ath"): "Math uab mathonwy oed ar|glwyd ar wyned" (6-shaped
  w; OCR "^ylùyd ar Oỳned"). No running text before it in the part (010 closes at l. 19).
- Close: col 89 l. 12 "… ac eu meirch ac eu harueu can mwyaf." (Evans *harueu*; the witness's *haruen* is a typo).

## Worklist items (38 check + 24 loss), decided on the image
OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the witness agrees with the image: col 81 l. 30 (kynwryf); col 82 ll. 1
(wastatrwyd), 8 (uorwyn), 11 (ansawd); col 83 l. 20 (keffir); col 84 ll. 11 (paub), 31 (Auory); col 85 l. 9
(wydat), l. 19 (the whole line: "a dywedeist neithwyr am y moch nas rodut ac nas guerthut. titheu nas…" — the OCR
scrambled it; the image agrees with the witness word for word); col 86 ll. 7 (doethant), 9 (Arwystli), 17 (y buant),
19–20 (the whole "Ha wyr … aniueileit hynn" line: decorated H; image = witness), 31, 33 (kerdyssawchi), 34;
col 87 ll. 20 (y gymryt), 27 (uaynawr), 33 (enkilyssant); col 88 ll. 3 (cheissaw), 7 (A guedy … o honunt), 10, 11,
13 (y ryngtaw), 20 (e ymlad), 26, 27 (kyffes), 35; col 89 l. 3 (oruu).

Raised letter (into the line):
- col 82 l. 15 — **"pa deryw ytti"**: Evans *der6* with *y* raised over *r*; the witness's *derw* is wrong (Red Book
  *padery6*). Same verb as *a pha deryw yti* three lines below.

Marks, not letters (as 005, 007, 010):
- col 83 l. 18 — "Je heb ! ynteu": a "!" at line end; nothing missing.
- col 83 l. 26 — "Nit drwc \ uyn trawscwyd": a "\" mark; nothing missing (Red Book "nyt d2wc vyntra6fg6yd").
- col 83 l. 9 — a dot after *arglwyd* in "hobeu arglwyd·": punctuation; the speech ends there.

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 82 ll. 2–3 — **"namyn Giluathwy uab Don o a Euyd uab Don, o nyeint ueibon y chwaer"**: Evans *giluath6y uab
  don o | a euyd uab don o nyeint uei|bon* (certain at zoom 10). The witness prints "[a Gwydyon] uab Don, y nyeint" —
  Williams's emendation; the Red Book has "giluaeth6y uab don. ac eueyd uab don ynyeint ueibon y ch6aer". So the
  White Book names **Euyd** (Eueyd) son of Don here, not Gwydion. The stray *o* at the end of l. 2 is a scribal slip
  (apparently the *o* of the following *o nyeint* begun too early); kept as written. *o nyeint* where the Red Book
  has *y nyeint* — kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the stray *o*; Euyd, not Gwydion; *o nyeint* (RB *y nyeint*) 'as
  nephews'/'of the nephews' — sense of *o* here uncertain, say so.
- col 82 l. 4 — "a'r teulu gyt ac wy y gylchu y wlat drostaw": the witness supplies [a aei]; not in Evans or the Red
  Book ("ar teulu gyt ac 6y ygylchu ywlat"); the clause is elliptic but readable (the verb understood from *gylchu*).
  Not supplied.
- col 83 l. 29 — **"hyt yg Heredigyawn"**: Evans *ýgheredigý|a6n* (gh, certain at zoom 10); witness *yg Keredigyawn*,
  Red Book *ygkeredigyawn*. Nasal mutation of K written *gh* (cf. *yghymherued* col 87). Divided *yg Heredigyawn*
  as *yg Kaer*.
- col 84 l. 30 — "Na dyro im y moch heno ac nacaha ui ohonunt": Evans has no *na* and no blank (witness supplies [na];
  Red Book "ac na naccaa ui ohonunt"). Not supplied: no gap in the White Book; probably *na* lost before *nacaha*
  (haplography). NOTE FOR DRAFTER: the sense intended is 'and do not refuse me them' (Red Book); as written the
  White Book lacks the negative.
- col 85 l. 8 — **"a deudec kynllyuan"**: Evans *kýnllýuan* (no *i*; witness *kynillyuan*). As the plural
  *kynllyuaneu* col 85 l. 24.
- col 85 l. 8–9 — "a neb o'r a guelei": the witness's supplied [e] dropped (Red Book "o2ae g6elei"). Not needed:
  'anyone of those who saw (them)'.
- col 85 l. 15 — "at Pryderi": Evans *pzýderi*; the witness's *Prydery* is its typo.
- col 87 l. 8 — "yd ymhwelwys **Guydyon** uab Don": Evans *guýdýon* (u), witness *Gwydyon*.
- col 87 l. 10 — **"hyt yg Kaer Dathyl"**: Evans *hýt*; the witness's *kyt* is its typo.
- col 87 l. 10 — **"Ac yguelei Uath uab Mathonwy"**: Evans *ýguelei uath* (certain); witness "yguely Math". Red Book
  "yg6elei uath". *yguelei* = *yg gwelei*, 'in the bed of' (a WB spelling of *gwely* with -ei; the Red Book agrees);
  *Uath* softened as Evans prints it. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 87 l. 29 — **"A Phyderi a'y kyrchwys"**: Evans *A phýderi* (no r-rotunda; certain at zoom 10). A readable slip
  for *Phryderi*; kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 87 l. 33 — "hyt y lle a elwir": Evans *ýlle*; the witness's *y Ue* is its typo.
- col 87 l. 36 — **"yr ayrua diueuessur y meint"**: Evans *diueueſſur* (certain at zoom 10); witness and Red Book
  *diuessur*. A dittography (*-ue-* written twice); kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 88 l. 27 — "Dygaf y Duw uyg kyffes, nat archaf i": the witness's [heb y Guydyon] dropped — not in Evans or the
  Red Book; the speaker is plain from the context.

## Forms kept for the drafter's notes
- *Euyd uab Don* and the stray *o* (above); *o nyeint* (RB *y nyeint*).
- *ac nacaha ui* without the negative (above).
- *pa deryw ytti* (raised y).
- *yg Heredigyawn* (nasal mutation written gh); *ygwarthaf*, *yghymherued* undivided as the witness.
- *Euyd*, *Giluathwy* / *Giluaethwy* (both in col 82, as Evans).
- *Hobeu* 'hobs' (the name of the beasts; the pun *hanner hwch, hanner hob*).
- *Kyredigyawn* (col 81) beside *Keredigyawn* (col 86): both as Evans.
- *yguelei Uath*; *Phyderi*; *diueuessur*.
- *Goewin* (cols 81, 82) and *Goewyn* (col 87): both as Evans.
- *Gwydyon* / *Guydyon* / *Wydyon*: as Evans at every occurrence (checked on the image).
- *Kaer Tathyl* (col 86, with T) beside *Kaer Dathyl* (cols 81, 87): both as Evans.
- *e ymlad*, *e Wydyon* (e for y 'to'), *E rof a Duw*, *E gwyr hynny* (e for the article) — as Evans.
- *pedwyryd ar ugeint* — as Evans; *Dol Penmaen* (Evans *pen maen*, two words; divided as the witness).

## Blanks, gaps and words not supplied
No blanks in cols 81–89 within the part. Not supplied (witness supplements the sense does not need, or no gap in
the White Book): [a Gwydyon] (Evans has *a Euyd*), [a aei], [na], [e], [heb y Guydyon].

## Word division and punctuation (ours)
The witness's, with its quotation marks " → “ ”; its "Hobeu, Arglwyd," "Pa ryw…" corrected to a full stop between
the two speeches; its comma after *ymlidywyd* before *Ac yna* corrected to a full stop; *gollyssynt. a llawer* →
comma (the list runs on); the two narrator's asides kept in ( ) as the witness (cf. 006), the second closing
"hanner hob.)".

## For the drafter (summary)
Large initial M; raised y in *deryw*; the "!" and "\" marks; *o a Euyd* — Euyd, not Gwydion, and the stray *o*;
*o nyeint*; *ac nacaha ui* (no negative; RB *na naccaa*); *yg Heredigyawn*; *kynllyuan*; *yguelei Uath*;
*Phyderi* (slip); *diueuessur* (dittography); Goewin/Goewyn; Kaer Tathyl/Dathyl; Kyredigyawn/Keredigyawn.
No words supplied.
